name: how a tick costs on a generated district, where routes cross roads

steps.note: routes are cheapest by the ground's walk cost: a pavement 1, grass 3, a road 5, so
a route that has to cross a street floods some pavement first to be sure there is
no cheaper way. Plaza (perf_simulation) is all floor and never pays that; this does
a crowd wandering the whole district, every walk a far route over its streets
a wall well above what a machine does, to catch an order of magnitude
